arguments.name: filename
arguments.notes: NUL-terminated filename; the export itself does not add .tga.

behavior: Loads an extended 8-bit glyph strip from TGA-like bytes. Reads width and height u16 at offsets12/14, uses height as square-cell size, skips18-byte header and copies rows in reverse vertical order. Stores allocation byte count=file_size-44. No TGA orientation/type validation is performed.

implementation_gaps: Checked native strip loader rejects zero/truncated/extreme dimensions and preserves safe ownership; native malformed-file fault paths are intentionally not reproduced. Dynamic extended fonts remain outside portable snapshots.

functions.name: PalFontDrawText

arguments.name: pixels
arguments.notes: Mutable tightly packed BGRA destination, at least width*height words.

arguments.name: text
arguments.notes: Build-specific NUL-terminated encoded text; reference draws only its first UTF-16LE code unit.

return.meaning: Returns1 after the draw path, including unsupported effect IDs and no visible glyphs. Does not report clipping or raster errors.

abi.cleanup: caller; export bodies return without an immediate stack pop

behavior: Draws into caller memory using current colors, size, type and effect. Automatically begins/ends context if needed.

Koikake and totsulover iterate the entire encoded string, process line breaks/spaces/br tags/percent glyphs; reference localized helper renders a single UTF-16LE code unit per call and Game.exe drives the loop.

Base glyphs are placed at origin+1,+1. Effect1 ORs the four cardinal neighbors; effect2 stamps a shadow at origin+2,+2; effect3 uses 12 radius2 diamond neighbors centered at origin+2,+2 and shifts the foreground by one extra pixel. Coverage0 skips; nonzero six-bit coverage maps to (4*coverage-1)&255. The color high byte is ORed rather than multiplied.

For translucent glyph pixels over a nontransparent destination, each color byte and alpha use a sum with weights alpha and255-alpha then shift right8. Native clipping paths have unsafe negative/zero edge cases; portable validation must not reproduce out-of-bounds accesses.

Bitmap glyph record is 24 bytes: u32 black-box width/height, i32 x/y origin, i16 x/y cell increments, then u32 coverage byte count. A zero lookup offset is not a native missing-glyph sentinel: lookup blindly adds it to the loaded resource base.

At scale1, metrics and coverage are copied unchanged. Otherwise signed origins and signed16 advances are multiplied by f32 scale and truncated; any resulting zero component is replaced by1. Width/height receive the same truncate-and-minimum1 treatment.

Native coverage resizing uses 8-bit fixed-point bilinear interpolation with steps trunc(256/scale). Neighbor pixels beyond the last source row/column are zero, not edge-replicated. Original coverage stride is (bitmap_bytes/original_height)&~3. No source size, division or scratch-capacity checks are present.

GetGlyphOutline query/fetch failures are not propagated. Metrics-only paths ignore GDI_ERROR; drawing paths may use stale metrics or the all-ones size on failure. Safe validation/fallback is an intentional difference from native undefined memory access.

Foreground directly stores color OR (coverage_alpha<<24) when coverage_alpha==255 or destination alpha==0. Other nonzero coverage blends all four channels with alpha and255-alpha weights divided by256; blended source alpha is255 independent of the color alpha byte.

Clipping trims only right/bottom counts using inclusive +1 arithmetic and does not skip the truncated source row tail. Foreground/outline paths do not consistently clamp negative x/y; shadow clamps its destination start only. Outline and MMX loops execute once even with zero dimensions. Safe port clipping must retain in-range arithmetic without recreating these invalid accesses.

At nonunit scale, scaled black-box width is derived from original padded coverage stride, not the original black-box width: trunc(original_stride*scale), minimum1, followed by profile-specific alignment.
implementation_gaps: External face metrics/coverage are portable ab_glyph substitutes, not Windows GDI-identical rasterization. Missing bitmap records use checked fallback instead of unchecked native lookup.
Checked adapters reject malformed text/resource extents and clip destination writes safely. Invalid native pointer access, scratch overflow, and zero-extent do-while writes are not reproduced.

Localized reference native DrawText consumes one UTF-16 unit, while the ordinary ADV Unicode renderer aggregates a whole line. Its low-level adapter preserves the native one-unit behavior; the whole-line fallback still uses portable face metrics.
build_specific_behavior: Only effects0,1,2 are implemented. Multibyte ANSI/Shift-JIS iteration uses CRT _mbsnextc/_mbsinc. Percent escape consumes exactly one following byte, index=byte-48; no range check in the strip extractor.

Scaled black-box width is narrowed to16 bits and aligned to4 before resampling. That aligned width determines the horizontal sampling ratio, so padding participates in horizontal scaling. Signed16 horizontal advance is raised to the aligned low16 width if smaller. Extended glyph crop has no index bounds check; grayscale conversion is (byte+1)>>2 before resizing.
Zero bitmap byte count still enters rescaling; zero source height can divide by zero.
